title: Godot web editor overheats my computer, and refuses to unfreeze when opening godot file
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.6.1.stable - Web - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - WebKit WebGL - (2 threads) ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable - Web - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - WebKit WebGL - (2 threads) ### Issue description Godot ventilated and overheated my computer heavy, even after 30ish minutes and a restart after godot web is closed, and refuses to unfreeze when opened godot file. I expect it to at least load without being stuck after many minutes. These screenshots are top (newest) to bottom (oldest) ^ Frozen screen that didn't open in several minutes and never opened Backpack scene My screen was ventilating hard here, even after like maybe 30 minutes after I closed godot web. Can move my character and stuff. Errors on the bottom (might wanna ingnore my upper script) Some other errors w my savemanager after moving it ### Steps to reproduce 1. So I got some inventory scripting, with a backpack that has its own separate scene, nothing to long but it is like around 5 scripts, doesn't really work sadly. 2. I turn on the occlusion in project settings. 3. Then, I start organizing a bunch of my files (all unsorted exept few in Trash folder because I can not delete those things in the web editor, which is another bug) by making a bunch of folders and moving the stuff in there both by dragging and dropping, and right click selected files --> move/duplicate to ---> move ---> (folder) 5. When I rename a folder it freezes for minutes then does its thing. (I think it's trying to rename it's children's paths slowly) 7. I estimate that there is 10+ folders. Maybe around 20. 8. I put on a bunch of performance settings (mostly stuff in rendering tab) 9. Do some more folder stuff. 10. Save project source 11. Open 12. Freezes with some parse errors (I know it has to do with something about the path I think) I'm not sure what order I put on the performance settings so the list might be a bit unchronological ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) ...
